title: Mexican Frankfurter Sandwich
description: A twist on the classic hot dog, this Mexican frankfurter sandwich features a tangy dutch frankfurter, topped with a blend of spices and served on a crispy sandwich roll.

ingredients.name: shredded cheese
ingredients.notes: cheddar or Monterey Jack work well

ingredients.name: sliced jalapeños
ingredients.notes: add as much or as little heat as you like

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a nice cooling touch

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Cook the tangy dutch frankfurter until nicely charred, about 5 minutes per side.
3. Meanwhile, toast the sandwich rolls by grilling them for about 2 minutes, or until lightly browned.
4. Assemble the sandwiches by placing a cooked frankfurter on each roll, followed by a spoonful of shredded cheese.
5. Add sliced jalapeños and a dollop of salsa on top of the cheese.
6. Finish with a dollop of sour cream, if using.
